messages:
Irene: quick heads-up from today's DR rehearsal. Observed cascading backlog when ap-southeast fell back to us-east. Key failure was missing per-route backpressure and a restore checklist that assumes instant KV cache invalidation. Listing actions + owners. Pls ack.

Irene: actions:\n1) per-route backpressure + request-shedding when warm-standby saturated (Sam)\n2) backup verification: add cross-region checksum compare job (Noah)\n3) runbook: add KV flush + warm-standby warmup steps + explicit fallback undo steps (Irene)\n4) telemetry: add failover SLO dashboard and synthetic traffic marker (Sam)\n5) ops cadence: monthly micro-dry-run + postgame 15m sync (Irene)

Sam: I'll do 1 & 4. Proposed inflight limits and an exponential backoff for fallback requests. Plan: design doc by Wed, PR by Fri, staging next Tue. snippet: 
```
backpressure: {
  per_route_limit: 1200,
  fallback_backoff: {base_ms: 100, factor: 2, max_ms: 2000}
}
```

Noah: checksum job for backups sounds good. Found parity issue where incremental apply order drifted causing a 2-3 min window of mismatch. I'll add an hourly checksum compare across regions and page if mismatch > 1 file. ETA: job + alert by Thu.

Irene: runbook updates: adding explicit commands for KV flush (protected), warmup script to spin up warm-standby threads, and an operator checklist. Draft out by Wed EOD. Need reviewers Sam + Noah.

recovery-bot: Reminder: micro-dry-run Wed 08:00 UTC in staging. Please RSVP.

Sam: +1 Wed 08:00, will attend and bring dashboard mockups

Noah: +1 will have checksum job on staging by then

Irene: thanks. I'll update the remediation tracker and send calendar invites. Weekly followups until PRs merged and runbook validated.

Sam: ack

Noah: ack

Irene: after the dry-run let's hold a 15m capture to log any telemetry gaps. I'll paste runbook diffs here before the drill.
